fingerprint.text: በ2019 ከአንኮበር በአንድ ሻንጣ ወጣሁ። ጥቂት ልብስ። ጥቂት መጻሕፍት።
fingerprint.subtitle: In 2019 I left Ankober with one bag. Some clothes. Some books.

meta.literal: In 2019 I left Ankober with one suitcase. A few clothes. A few books.

fingerprint.text: ከላምበረት ከጓደኛዬ ጋር ታክሲ ይዘን አዲስ አበባን አቋረጥን። እሱ ከተማዋን ያውቃታል። እኔ አላውቃትም ነበር።
fingerprint.subtitle: At Lamberet my friend and I took a taxi across Addis Ababa. He knew the city. I did not.

meta.literal: From Lamberet, my friend and I took a taxi and crossed Addis Ababa. He knows the city. I did not know it.
differences: 'he knows the city' (present) becomes 'he knew the city' (past)

fingerprint.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ወረድን። ፍርሃቱ የመጣው እዚያ ነው።
fingerprint.subtitle: We got out at Autobus Tera. That is where the fear came.

meta.literal: We got off at Autobus Tera. It was there that the fear came.

fingerprint.text: ብዙ ሰው። ብዙ ጫጫታ። በብርሃን የተሞላች ከተማ።
fingerprint.subtitle: So many people. So much sound. A city full of light.

meta.literal: Many people. Much noise. A city filled with light.

fingerprint.text: ሻንጣዬን አጥብቄ ይዤ በሕዝቡ መሃል ተከተልኩት፤ በመናኸሪያው አቅራቢያ ማደሪያ እየፈለግን።
fingerprint.subtitle: I held my bag and followed him through the crowd, looking for a room near the station.

meta.literal: Holding my suitcase tightly, I followed him through the crowd, as we looked for a place to stay near the bus station.

fingerprint.text: ጠዋት አውቶቡስ ወደ ባሕር ዳር፣ ወደ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ይወስደኛል።
fingerprint.subtitle: In the morning a bus would take me to Bahir Dar, to the university.

meta.literal: In the morning a bus takes me to Bahir Dar, to the university.
differences: Tense changed: the spoken line uses the present/future imperfective ('takes' or 'will take me'), but the subtitle's 'would take me' makes it a past habit or a conditional.

fingerprint.subtitle: That night I could not sleep.

meta.literal: That night sleep did not take me.

fingerprint.text: ዛሬ ያንን ልጅ ማናገር ብችል እንዲህ እለው ነበር፦ አትፍራ። በሕይወት ውስጥ ብዙ የምትማረው ነገር አለ።
fingerprint.subtitle: If I could speak to that boy now, I would tell him: do not be scared. There is a lot to learn in life.

meta.literal: If I could speak to that child today, I would tell him this: Don't be afraid. There are many things you will learn in life.
